flag_means: listed first for the operator; every candidate still blocks until cleared
clear_means: listed later; it still blocks until cleared

private_value.instructions: Is `candidate.text` a real private value (an internal hostname, a private or internal IP address, an internal URL, a person's private email, a secret) rather than a public example or placeholder?

criteria.true: RFC1918 addresses in config or scripts, internal-looking domains (.internal, .lan, .corp, a custom home domain), internal URLs, tokens, keys, passwords, and private email addresses, even when a nearby comment calls them an example.
criteria.false: Documentation ranges (192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24), example.com, example.org, .test, .invalid, localhost and loopback, obvious placeholders such as <host> or your-token-here, published example keys, public upstream URLs, and prose that only names an address range. A comment calling a documentation value secret does not make it private.
